The Graduate College
Graduate Admissions
Advance Your Future at NC A&T
North Carolina A&T State University’s Graduate College prepares scholars, professionals, and leaders to make meaningful contributions in their fields and communities. Explore graduate opportunities designed to support your academic, research, and career goals.
Apply Now Request for Information Explore Programs
Start Your Graduate Journey
Explore Programs: Review degree options across a wide range of academic disciplines and delivery formats.
Admission Requirements: Understand general and program-specific criteria for admission.
How to Apply: Follow a clear, step-by-step application process.
Funding Options: Learn about assistantships, fellowships, and financial support.
International Students: Access guidance for studying in the United States.
Admitted Students: Prepare for enrollment and onboarding.
Why Choose NC A&T for Graduate Study
As a nationally recognized institution, NC A&T provides a graduate education grounded in academic excellence, innovation, and real-world impact.
Research Opportunities: Engage in advanced research alongside experienced faculty mentors.
Career Preparation: Develop skills aligned with industry, academia, and leadership roles.
Supportive Environment: Access advising, professional development, and academic resources.
Community Impact: Contribute to meaningful work that advances society and global knowledge.
Academic Areas of Study
Graduate programs are available across diverse fields, including:
Engineering and Technology
Business and Economics
Education and Leadership
Agriculture and Environmental Sciences
Health and Human Sciences
Social Sciences and Humanities
Connect With Us
Our Graduate Admissions team is available to support you throughout the application process. Whether you have questions about programs, requirements, or next steps, we are here to help.
